scenarios: History: review action only for COMPLETED
Submit: rating/comment, success, prevent repeat and safe text rendering
Reload: saved review persists, no new form
Duplicate 409: load existing review and remove form
Server error: preserve input, retry succeeds
Public field reviews: pagination switches page
Empty field: empty state, no fabricated rating
Mobile form: rating/comment visible without horizontal overflow
note: Intercepted API fixtures, no SQL or live customer writes.
